criteria.first_submission: Submit the first section for review

panel.title: Administrator dashboard
panel.lead: Overview of the accounts and the status of the platform.
panel.noUsersTitle: There are no other users yet
panel.noUsersText: Create the first student or teacher account to get started.

users.lead: Create, edit and deactivate accounts, and set each user's type.
users.noMatchText: Try a different name, email or filter.
users.emptyText: Create the first account using the form.
users.reactivateText: This person will be able to sign in again with their password.
users.deactivateText: They will not be able to sign in, but their contributions and history are kept. You can reactivate the account at any time.
users.deleteText: The account has no recorded contributions. This action cannot be undone.
users.resetHint: If this person forgot their password, you can assign them a new temporary one.
users.tempNote: A temporary password will be assigned, which the user must change the first time they sign in.
users.resetText: Their current password will stop working, and they must change the new one the next time they sign in.
users.tempShare: Share this temporary password with {name} ({email}). They must change it the first time they sign in.
users.tempOnce: For security reasons it will not be shown again. If it is lost, assign a new one from Edit.

periods.lead: Teachers can only create teams in active terms.
periods.emptyText: Create the first semester with the form so teachers can set up teams.
periods.deactivateText: Teachers will not be able to create new teams in it. Existing teams and progress are kept.
periods.activateText: Teachers will be able to create teams in this term.

achievements.lead: Platform-wide badges awarded to teams when they meet each criterion.
achievements.emptyText: Create the first achievement to motivate the teams.
achievements.uploadHint: PNG or SVG, up to 200 KB. Or choose one from the list.

alreadyWon.one: {count} team has already earned this achievement. If you change the name or icon, they will see the update and keep the date it was earned.
alreadyWon.other: {count} teams have already earned this achievement. If you change the name or icon, they will see the update and keep the date it was earned.

achievements.fileTooBig: The file is {size} KB; the maximum is {max} KB.
achievements.readError: The file could not be read. Try another one.
achievements.pointsInvalid: Points must be a whole number, 0 or greater.

willLose.one: {count} team has it and will lose it.
willLose.other: {count} teams have it and will lose it.

deletedFrom.one: The achievement was deleted and removed from {count} team.
deletedFrom.other: The achievement was deleted and removed from {count} teams.

backups.lead: The platform makes an automatic backup every week. You can also generate a manual one whenever you need it.
backups.manualText: Includes users, teams, sections, versions, comments, achievements and activity logs. It downloads as a compressed file (.sql.gz).
backups.confirmText: To generate the backup, enter your password again.
backups.emptyText: The first automatic backup will be generated within the next hour, or you can generate a manual one now.
backups.generated: Backup generated ({size}). The download has started.
